beats.headline: Please do not get on
beats.text: For the record: the Dismemberment Limited is a sleek white train of three cars, one pair of doors, and a lone operator on a bouncy seat behind a glass nose. Subject notices crawlers on the platform the moment they notice him. Please, he says as the doors open. Find another way. We're not open to crawlers. The car around him is caked floor to ceiling in dried gore. Subject wears only his engineer's hat and green-tinted skin that hangs off him like a fitted sheet.

beats.headline: Two creatures, one name
beats.text: The file: two creatures, intelligent only together. The bones belonged to a hobgoblin. The skin is a Flesher, peeled from a Basher Troll by a war mage's You're Not Done Yet spell; it melted its victim and cast Boned, and the thing that stood up was new to the world, confused, afraid and easy to kill. Other Fleshers come for such things, and each resleeving comes back smarter. A footnote: this is Levi the 7th. The quest has triggered six times since the floor opened.

beats.headline: Levi is On the Menu
beats.text: The doors close. The back doors only open when crawlers are aboard, subject explains, and it hurts so bad when they get to him. Quest: do not allow Levi the 7th to be devoured; failure turns every crawler on the train into a Flesher. Subject spends the siege at the front predicting the end while Crawler Carl and Crawler Katia hold an eight-hundred-pound plate against the door. The war mage behind it is Dismember. Stay away from me, subject shouts. You don't control me anymore.

beats.headline: Waving from the window
beats.text: Dismember's head is off, pulled through a hole in the plate. The Fleshers, now Bereft Minions, swarm the barrier, and one of them takes the war mage's body. Subject screams for most of the remaining trip: You did it! By the gods, you killed him! and a dozen more shapes wait in the third car. At the stop the door to car two slides closed on its own; the crawlers take the head and their plates and get off. Subject waves as the train leaves the station.
